title: Hostel bank: accounts, transfers and statements

authoring.author: Parikshaa content team
authoring.originality: Written for Parikshaa: our own project brief, code, tests and rubric for hostel bank: accounts, transfers and statements, examples, code, quiz and explanations; no text from any site, book or course.

brief: The hostel runs a small savings scheme: students keep money with the office, take it out, and send it to each other. Build the accounts so a balance can never go negative, a transfer either happens completely or not at all, and every account can print its statement.
requirements: An account's balance is private and never negative; only deposit and withdraw change it.
A transfer checks everything first (both accounts exist, not the same account, enough money) and then moves the money: never half a transfer.
Every change is recorded in the account's history with the balance after it.
Amounts are whole rupees from 1 to 999,999,999; anything else is refused.
io_protocol:
| Command | Prints |
|---|---|
| `OPEN <id> <owner>` | `opened <id> for <owner>` or `error: account <id> exists` |
| `DEPOSIT <id> <amount>` | `<id> balance <b>` |
| `WITHDRAW <id> <amount>` | `<id> balance <b>` or `error: insufficient funds in <id>` |
| `TRANSFER <from> <to> <amount>` | `moved <amount> from <from> to <to>` or an error |
| `STATEMENT <id>` | `<n>. <entry> -> <balance>` lines, or `no transactions` |

Transfers appear in statements as `withdraw` and `deposit` entries. Errors: `error: no account <id>`, `error: same account`, `error: bad amount <text>`, `error: bad command <line>`.

milestones.title: A safe account
milestones.instructions: Fill in `deposit` and `withdraw`. A withdrawal that would go below zero changes nothing and returns false.
hints: Check before changing: the history must not contain a failed withdrawal.
Record the balance after the change in the history line.

milestones.title: All-or-nothing transfers
milestones.instructions: Fill in `Bank.transfer`: do every check first, then withdraw and deposit.
hints: If the money check came after the withdrawal you would have to undo it; check first instead.
Compare the two Account objects to catch a transfer to the same account.

rubric.criterion: Hidden tests pass: every command prints exactly the expected output.
Account keeps balance and history private; Bank.transfer checks everything before changing anything.
Readable names, small functions and clear error handling (AI feedback, advice only).

extensions: Add a daily withdrawal limit per account.
Print the three accounts with the highest balance.
